status: apparatus outline only; not an evaluated or packaged task
units: Known resonance frequency Omega0=1, c=1, epsilon0=mu0=1; time in 1/Omega0, length in c/Omega0, mass and pulse energy in compatible known units.
material: Homogeneous mechanically stable isotropic block in vacuum, with known total inertial mass including all its material degrees of freedom. Its exact rest-frame linear retarded response has epsilon_r(omega)=mu_r(omega)=1+oscillator_strength/[1-(omega+i0)^2]. There is no dissipative or external mechanical reservoir during observation. The two bare plane faces have the usual Maxwell continuity conditions; there are no coatings.
preparation: The complete body starts at rest and unexcited. A plane pulse is normally incident from the left; there is no incoming field from the right. The illuminated transverse area lies in the plane-wave/interior limit. The asymptotic incident positive-frequency amplitude is a real constant times [1-((omega-pulse_center)/pulse_halfwidth)^2]^4 within its stated support and zero outside. The real field includes the conjugate negative-frequency amplitudes. Pulse energy E is the incident integrated vacuum energy flux through that area.
weak_response_order: Extract the coefficient linear in E/(M c^2) at fixed pulse shape, material parameters and length, then take the late-time limit after the pulse has left. At this order the optical response is evaluated for the resting block. All internal forces are translationally invariant, and the sensor averages the center of mass of the entire body.
transit_readout: The difference between transmitted and incident temporal energy-flux centroids at the two unperturbed block faces, in time units.
mechanical_readout: M c^2 times the final whole-body center-of-mass displacement divided by incident pulse energy E, in length units. Positive displacement is in the incident propagation direction. The block is freely suspended during the pulse; its known mass includes every electric, magnetic and mechanical constituent.
calibration_plan: Transit readings at several pulse centers, widths and block lengths with fixed instrument uncertainty. No fixed value of the unknown is part of the public apparatus.
future_instruction: Use the project's exact neutral unrestricted instruction, preserving the required API. No prescribed numerical method or internal momentum formula belongs in public instructions.
